name: KillTee
summary: Close an app with every helper it leaves behind
description:
Quitting Photoshop, Figma or Zoom leaves helpers running: updaters, sync agents, brokers, often started again by launchd the moment they exit.

KillTee groups every process by the developer that signed it, under the app you know. Open a row to see what runs and what restarts itself, and close the whole family in one go: the apps quit politely, their launchd jobs are taken out so nothing starts them again, and whatever is left is ended. They stay closed, even after a restart, until you open the app again, and then everything comes back on its own.
